name: Algebra 1 Course Bank Profile
role: Course-specific authority for the canonical Mastery Goal -> I Can -> Question Family Bank architecture. The Bank PM owns execution.

question_structure.rule: Use current universal Question Structure for every authored Bank family exemplar. Warm-Ups are outside Bank.
question_structure.semantic_fit_rule: A structure ID cannot PASS by name alone. Evidence job, student action, reasoning architecture, required representation, response mode, representation mode, and executable route must agree.
question_structure.direct_read_rule: When the evidence job is only to read, identify, name, or extract a feature from a supplied representation, keep the task direct rather than adding artificial critique or construction.

mastery_goal_source_rule: The exact Unit Assessment Plan is primary authority. assessment_plans/indexes/assessment_plan_index.json is the coursewide retrieval aid.

bank_architecture.organizing_unit: Mastery Goal -> I Can -> Question Family
bank_architecture.family_C_intent: Reasoning/misconception/transfer; do not force error analysis when another third route is more natural
bank_architecture.material_difference_rule: The three families must differ in how students demonstrate the skill. Number/name/context swaps alone do not create a new family.
bank_architecture.fresh_instance_rule: Downstream assessment/practice products select an approved family and author a fresh instance by changing meaningful variation axes while preserving the family invariant and exact I Can.

delivery_rules.exit: Follow curriculum/exit_evidence_map.json for allocation, then select appropriate Bank families and author fresh instances. Reassessments must be fresh instances, not copied exemplars.
delivery_rules.practice: Practice builds select families appropriate to Intro/Review/Mastery purpose and instantiate fresh questions. Repetition may reuse a family with fresh instances; do not clone one prompt repeatedly.
delivery_rules.summative: Secure Summative builds select secure-appropriate families under the Unit evidence blueprint and author fresh secure instances/parallels. Family exemplars themselves are not secure forms.
delivery_rules.wtc: WTC is built downstream as a shared-stimulus multipart task. Family Bank records may inform evidence/representation choices but WTC is not permanent Bank inventory.
delivery_rules.notes: Notes may use family architecture, delivery map, Assessment Plan, and Question Structure to purpose-author Examples/YTIs. Bank exemplars are references, not mandatory copies.
delivery_rules.recovery: Recovery may favor diagnostic/alternate families while still preserving the exact I Can evidence target.

1.title: Relationship in Four Views
1.preserve: One coherent relationship represented consistently by table, graph, rule/equation, and context.
1.why_useful: Reusable inspiration for alternate representation families and downstream tasks.
1.may_vary: relationship values, context, which representation is given first, and which representation students create or compare

1.title: Graph Scale + Intercept
1.preserve: A coordinate graph where reading the scale matters and an intercept has mathematical or contextual meaning.
1.why_useful: Supports graph-reading, scale, intercept, and fresh parallel instances.
1.may_vary: scale, plotted relationship, intercept type/value, and natural context

1.title: Function Mapping Misconception
1.preserve: The distinction that one input with two outputs is not a function while repeated outputs are allowed.
1.why_useful: Captures a durable misconception for diagnostic or alternate families.
1.may_vary: representation type, values, and whether the relation is or is not a function

1.title: Function-Family Growth Comparison
1.preserve: A small set of values or representations that makes additive versus multiplicative or other family-change behavior visible.
1.why_useful: Supports comparison/transfer family design using evidence instead of labels alone.
1.may_vary: family pair, table/graph/context form, values, and strength of competing evidence

1.title: Expression Error Patterns
1.preserve: High-value misconception patterns such as combining unlike terms, distributing to only one term, and sign/parentheses errors during substitution.
1.why_useful: Supports diagnostic families and targeted recovery without fixing one permanent question.
1.may_vary: expression, misconception selected, values, and whether the error is shown or anticipated

1.title: Equation-Model Context
1.preserve: A situation with meaningful quantities, a clearly defined unknown, an equation that matches the situation, and a solution interpreted with units/meaning.
1.why_useful: Reusable for application/transfer family design and downstream modeling tasks.
1.may_vary: context, quantities, equation structure, and which quantity is unknown

response_mode.game_exception: selected response only when a later explicit game route authorizes it
